---
title: "maps"
subtitle: "Hierarchical Geographic Maps with Sea-Distance Analysis"
---

## Overview

The `maps` R package draws hierarchical administrative boundary maps for EU countries and computes sea-distance metrics via spatial adjacency graphs.

### Ireland Example

Ireland serves as the primary case study with its administrative hierarchy:

| Level | Count | Source |
|-------|------:|--------|
| Countries (island) | 3 | IE, NI, island outline |
| Provinces | 4 | Connacht, Leinster, Munster, Ulster |
| Counties | 32 | Traditional counties |

### Sea Distance

Counties are classified by graph distance from the coast:

- **Distance 0**: Counties touching the sea
- **Distance 1**: Counties adjacent to a coastal county
- **Distance 2**: Counties two hops from the coast

See the [Dashboard](vignettes/articles/dashboard.qmd) for interactive maps.

## Installation

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("JohnGavin/maps")
```

### Nix

```bash
# Clone and enter the reproducible nix shell
git clone https://github.com/JohnGavin/maps.git
cd maps
nix-shell default.nix
```

The `default.nix` provides R 4.5.3 with all dependencies (sf, giscoR, igraph,
leaflet, etc.) pinned to a specific nixpkgs snapshot for full reproducibility.

:::
